meta.description: Query UniProt's REST API (rest.uniprot.org) for entries, search and stream TSV, async ID mapping, isoforms, cross-references, UniRef clusters and proteomes through a small Python requests client.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers or values; P04637 393 aa, 311 PDB, 9 isoforms and 20431 human Swiss-Prot rows matched independent service totals.

methodological_ground.detail: Silent first-page truncation in map_ids and the quickstart search is a data-completeness defect filed as UNI-001 and UNI-005; the Skill itself warns about the 500-record cap and stream vs search.

code_usability.detail: Every client function ran; failures are a rejected proteome route (UNI-002), a list formatted as text in one example (UNI-003) and a missing inactive-entry guard (UNI-006), scored in Layers 1-2 and filed P1/P2.

functional_suitability.note: Entry, search, stream, isoform and xref functions correct live; map_ids drops mappings, download_proteome route is rejected, uniref_cluster mislabels fields, and two documented query/field names do not work.

reliability.note: No request timeouts or 429 handling; map_ids truncates silently with no failedIds signal; an inactive accession raises KeyError; stream_tsv buffers the whole response.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md about 200 lines with large reference tables that duplicate UniProt's own docs.

agent_usability.note: Good stream-vs-search, async-mapping and fields guidance; the quickstart ID-mapping and kinase examples print truncated results as complete.

human_usability.note: Clear tables; the Combine query example silently returns 0 hits and one documented field name is rejected with HTTP 400.

security.note: No credentials; HTTPS only; accessions interpolated into URL paths without validation (low risk).

maintainability.note: One 140-line client with docstrings; no tests, so truncation and the dead proteome route shipped.

agent_specific.note: Specific trigger description and escape hatches; one example crashes and another presents capped output as totals.

inputs.label: Entry parse, bulk search and stream (uniprot_query.py first three sections)
inputs.note: Entry and stream are exact (stream 20431 rows equals server total); the kinase search returns 500 of 640 matches and the example prints '500 reviewed human kinases' as if complete.

assertions.text: fetch_entry_json('P04637') returns TP53, 393 aa, reviewed, 311 PDB, AlphaFold P04637
assertions.note: Exact; pdb_count matches the xref_pdb TSV field (311).

assertions.text: stream_tsv returns every human Swiss-Prot entry without duplicates
assertions.note: 20431 rows equal X-Total-Results; no duplicate accessions; P04637 present.

assertions.text: Secondary and unreviewed accessions parse correctly
assertions.note: Q15086 resolves to P04637; a TrEMBL entry yields reviewed=False and a protein name.

assertions.text: The shipped kinase search reports the full match set
assertions.note: 500 rows versus 640 server total; nothing in the output flags the cap.

assertions.text: Documented keyword:"Kinase" and keyword:KW-0418 are equivalent
assertions.note: 640 versus 625 matches for the same human reviewed filter.

inputs.label: Async Ensembl-to-UniProtKB ID mapping (map_ids, uniprot_query.py last section)
inputs.note: Job runs and polls correctly but only the first results page is read: 25 of 44 rows; BRCA2 (ENSG00000139618) is absent with no failedIds entry and PTEN has 7 of 12 rows.

assertions.text: Submit, poll and fetch complete for three Ensembl gene IDs
assertions.note: Job finished; invalid from_db raises HTTP 400.

assertions.text: All mapped rows for every input ID are returned
assertions.note: Client 25 rows versus 44 from idmapping/stream; X-Total-Results 44 and a Link next header were ignored.

assertions.text: A dropped input is reported, not silent
assertions.note: BRCA2 has zero rows and failedIds is empty; the example prints no NOT MAPPED line.

assertions.text: Reviewed-only mapping is reachable
assertions.note: to_db='UniProtKB-Swiss-Prot' returns P04637, P60484, P51587 within one page.

inputs.label: Isoforms, FASTA and cross-reference summary (isoforms_and_xrefs.py)
inputs.note: Library calls are correct (9 isoforms, one canonical, FASTA lengths 393/341/346/354/302/307/261/209/214, 104 databases, PDB 311); the shipped example exits 1 with TypeError formatting a list.

assertions.text: list_isoforms('P04637') returns nine isoforms with exactly one canonical
assertions.note: P04637-1 canonical.

assertions.text: fetch_isoform_fasta returns sequences for every isoform
assertions.note: Nine FASTA records; P04637-2 is 341 aa.

assertions.text: xref_summary agrees with the xref_pdb field
assertions.note: PDB 311 both ways; Ensembl 22.

assertions.text: The shipped example runs to completion
assertions.note: TypeError: unsupported format string passed to list.__format__ at the isoform print.

inputs.label: Proteome download, UniRef cluster, inactive and secondary accessions
inputs.note: download_proteome returns HTTP 400 on the documented route (stream route works, gzip magic 1f8b); uniref_cluster labels entryType as identity and returns an entry name; a deleted accession raises KeyError.

assertions.text: download_proteome('UP000000625') downloads the proteome
assertions.note: HTTP 400 'upid value has invalid format'.

assertions.text: uniref_cluster returns a representative accession and a cluster identity
assertions.note: representative is P53_HUMAN (entry name); identity is the string 'UniRef50' from entryType; JSON has no identity field.

assertions.text: An inactive accession fails with a clear error
assertions.note: HTTP 200 'Inactive' record raises KeyError: 'sequence'.

assertions.text: resolve_obsolete maps a secondary accession to the current primary

inputs.label: Documented query syntax, field names, endpoint table, cursor paging
inputs.note: Most routes, suffixes and queries work and cursor paging returns 500 + 125 = 625 rows; xref:pdb silently returns 0 hits and ft_active_site is rejected.

assertions.text: Documented endpoints and .json/.fasta/.tsv/.xml/.txt/.gff suffixes respond
assertions.note: All 200 including /uniprotkb/accessions, /uniref/search, /proteomes/{upid}, /taxonomy/{id}.

assertions.text: Cursor paging returns the remainder of a 625-hit result
assertions.note: Second page 125 rows via the Link header.

assertions.text: The documented Combine query returns hits
assertions.note: keyword:KW-0067 AND xref:pdb returns 0; database:pdb returns 904 for the same filter.

assertions.text: Every documented fields name is accepted
assertions.note: ft_active_site gives HTTP 400; the valid name is ft_act_site.

assertions.text: Stated corpus sizes are current
assertions.note: TrEMBL is described as about 250M; live release 2026_03 reports 149.4M (Swiss-Prot 575,748).

key_strengths: Entry, stream, isoform and cross-reference functions return exact values verified two ways: P04637 393 aa, 311 PDB, 9 isoforms with FASTA lengths, human Swiss-Prot stream 20431 rows equal to the server total.
Stream-vs-search, async mapping with a hard timeout, isoform suffix handling and secondary-accession resolution are accurate and verified live.
Most documented endpoints, suffixes and query operators work, and cursor paging reproduces the full 625-hit result.

recommendations.title: UNI-001 map_ids reads only the first results page
recommendations.problem: Ensembl-to-UniProtKB mapping returned 25 of 44 rows; BRCA2 vanished with empty failedIds and PTEN lost 5 rows; the quickstart and example print the partial list as complete. Ensembl-to-UniProtKB also returns many TrEMBL fragments (18 rows for TP53).
recommendations.root_cause: The client fetches /idmapping/results once and ignores X-Total-Results and the Link next header.
recommendations.fix: Fetch /idmapping/stream/{jobId} (or follow Link), report inputs with no rows, and document to_db='UniProtKB-Swiss-Prot' for reviewed-only mapping; add a regression on the three example genes.

recommendations.title: UNI-002 download_proteome documented route returns 400
recommendations.problem: /proteomes/{upid}.fasta.gz is rejected for UP000000625 and the endpoint table and client both use it.
recommendations.root_cause: The route does not exist on the current service; it was never executed.
recommendations.fix: Use /uniprotkb/stream?query=proteome:{upid}&format=fasta&compressed=true (200, gzip verified) and correct the endpoint table.

recommendations.title: UNI-003 isoforms_and_xrefs.py raises TypeError
recommendations.problem: The example formats iso['ids'] (a list) with a width specifier and exits at the first isoform line, before the FASTA, xref and proteome sections.
recommendations.root_cause: list_isoforms returns ids as a list but the example treats it as a string.
recommendations.fix: Join the ids (', '.join(iso['ids'])) and rerun the whole example.

recommendations.title: UNI-004 xref:pdb and ft_active_site documented but broken
recommendations.problem: The query table and the Combine example use xref:pdb, which silently returns 0 hits (database:pdb returns 904), and the fields table lists ft_active_site, which the service rejects with HTTP 400.
recommendations.root_cause: Query and field names were not tested against the live service.
recommendations.fix: Replace xref:pdb with database:pdb (or structure_3d:true) and ft_active_site with ft_act_site.

recommendations.title: UNI-005 Capped results and stale counts shown as totals
recommendations.problem: The kinase example prints 500 as the number of reviewed human kinases (server total 640), keyword:"Kinase" differs from keyword:KW-0418 (640 vs 625), and TrEMBL is stated as about 250M (live 149.4M).
recommendations.root_cause: search_tsv returns one page without reporting X-Total-Results; counts copied from older sources.
recommendations.fix: Warn when rows equal the cap (or return the total), use KW-0418 in the example, and update the corpus sizes.

recommendations.title: UNI-006 Inactive accession raises KeyError
recommendations.problem: A deleted accession returns HTTP 200 with entryType Inactive and no sequence, so fetch_entry_json raises KeyError; SKILL.md says obsolete accessions return 404 or 301.
recommendations.root_cause: No inactive-entry guard and the behaviour is documented from memory.
recommendations.fix: Detect entryType == 'Inactive', raise a clear error naming inactiveReason, and correct the failure-mode text (secondary accessions redirect and resolve).

recommendations.title: UNI-007 uniref_cluster mislabels identity and representative
recommendations.problem: identity is the entryType string 'UniRef50' (there is no identity field) and representative is the entry name P53_HUMAN, not an accession.
recommendations.root_cause: Field mapping chosen without checking the response.
recommendations.fix: Return identity as the numeric tier parsed from the id and the first representativeMember accession (P04637) alongside the member id.

recommendations.title: UNI-008 No timeouts, retries or 429 handling in the client
recommendations.problem: Every request lacks a timeout and Retry-After handling; stream_tsv buffers the full response in memory, and map_ids treats any non-RUNNING status as finished.
recommendations.root_cause: Minimal client without a shared request helper.
recommendations.fix: Add one helper with timeout and Retry-After, check FAILED job status, and stream large responses to disk.

recommendations.title: UNI-009 No Skill-root LICENSE file
recommendations.problem: Preflight warns that the manifest cites repository license evidence only; frontmatter says MIT.
recommendations.root_cause: Origin repository carries the licence at its root.
recommendations.fix: Cite the upstream MIT licence evidence in provenance or add a LICENSE file.
